verdict.rationale: HubSpot's own pages describe a built-in Breeze Assistant that builds reports from plain-language requests, plus a team of in-product AI agents. These include a prospecting agent that reaches out automatically, single-goal campaign planning, auto-drafted CRM updates and follow-ups for approval, and brand-voice content creation. Together that is a clear in-product delegation story. Missing for 10: in-depth knowledge-base documentation of the assistant's task scope and limits (evidence is marketing-page level), and independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works as claimed.
